item.text: Tolpis barbata (“Black Eyes,” also called European umbrella milkwort) is a flowering plant in the Asteraceae family. It is native to the Mediterranean region, including Portugal, Spain, Gibraltar, Morocco, Algeria, and Tunisia. Elsewhere—including California and New South Wales—it is introduced and commonly regarded as a weed. [s1:p1]
